apiKeysDescription: Manage API keys for integrating Dynopay into your applications

documentation.title: API Documentation
documentation.description: Learn how to integrate Dynopay into your application with our complete API documentation

currency.baseCurrencyHelper: The currency you price in — buyers still pay in Bitcoin, Ethereum or stablecoins.
currency.confirmBody: Setting the settlement currency to {{currency}} affects real settlement: new payments will be priced and receipted in {{currency}}. It does not change past payments. Your paired development (test) key will be updated to match.

delete.title: Delete API key
delete.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this API key? Applications using this key will no longer be able to access the API. This action cannot be undone.

security.title: Security Best Practices:
security.description: Keep your API keys secure and never share them publicly. If you suspect a key has been compromised, delete it immediately and create a new one.

generate.modalSubtitle: Generate a new API key to integrate Dynopay into your app
generate.successSubtitle: Save this key now - you won't be able to see it again
generate.securityMessage: Make sure to copy your API key now. For security reasons, we won't show it again. Store it securely and never share it publicly.

withdrawalWhitelist.title: Withdrawal Whitelist
withdrawalWhitelist.description: Once enabled, your account will only be able to withdraw to addresses on your whitelist.

keys.liveUnlockHint: Your live key activates automatically once you add (or reuse) your first wallet on this brand.
keys.tryFirstPaymentSubtitle: Fastest way to feel Dynopay. Copy-paste this into your terminal — it uses your sandbox key and creates a $5 test checkout link.
keys.tryFirstPaymentCopyAria: Copy cURL command with your real test key
keys.tryFirstPaymentFooterHint: The redirect_url is a hosted checkout page — open it in a browser to complete the test payment.
keys.copyNowNotice: Copy this key now — for security it will not be shown again once you leave this page.
keys.shownOnceNotice: Keys are shown once. Only a one-way hash is stored, so this key can't be revealed — press Regenerate to get a new one you can copy.
keys.tryFirstPaymentRegenerate: Regenerate sandbox key to copy it
keys.tryFirstPaymentKeyUnavailable: Your sandbox key is stored as a one-way hash, so it can't be shown here. Regenerate it once, copy it, and the command below will work out of the box.

buyButtons.modalIntro: A buy button is a pre-created checkout object. Because the amount and currencies live server-side, shoppers can’t tamper with the price in your page’s HTML.
buyButtons.priceFixed: Fixed price — you set the amount
buyButtons.amountHint: Amount must be ≥ 5 (base currency of your active secret key).
buyButtons.rangeHint: Shopper picks any amount in this range at checkout. Min must be ≥ 5.
buyButtons.allowedCurrenciesPlaceholder: e.g. USDT-TRC20, USDC-ERC20 — leave empty to allow all configured
buyButtons.descriptionPlaceholder: Shown to shoppers on the checkout page
buyButtons.successUrlPlaceholder: https://shop.com/thanks — where to send the shopper after payment
buyButtons.metadataInvalidPre: Metadata must be a valid JSON object (e.g.
buyButtons.metadataHint: Attached to every session created from this button — useful for reconciling webhooks server-side.
buyButtons.title: Buy buttons
buyButtons.sectionDescPost: path is the canonical Stripe-style flow — because the amount lives server-side, shoppers can’t tamper with the price in your HTML.
buyButtons.selectCompany: Select a brand to manage its buy buttons.
buyButtons.empty: No buy buttons yet. Create one to embed a tamper-proof checkout on your site.
buyButtons.deleteMessage: Once archived, this buy button can no longer create checkout sessions. Any pages on your site using it will stop working until you reactivate it (or replace the button-id with a new one).

pk.formIntro: Publishable keys are safe to use in browser code. Every request from them is checked against the domains you list below.
pk.domainsHelp: Comma or space separated. Accepts full URLs (https://shop.com) or wildcard subdomains (*.shop.com). Requests from other origins are rejected.
pk.maxAmountHelp: The largest single payment this key can create (in your base currency). Amount must be ≥ 5.
pk.allowedCurrenciesPlaceholder: e.g. USDT-TRC20, USDC-ERC20 — leave empty to allow all configured wallets
pk.createdBannerBody: This key is safe to use in browser code. Copy it below — you can also re-copy it any time from the list.
pk.statusUpdateFailed: Failed to update publishable key status
pk.sectionDescription: Browser-safe keys for drop-in <dynopay-buy-button>. Each key is domain-locked and amount-capped. Requires an active secret key of the same environment.
pk.selectCompany: Select a brand to manage its publishable keys.
pk.emptyBody: Publishable keys let you embed a Buy Button or checkout on your own site. Create one to get your first embeddable snippet.
pk.revokeModalMessage: Once revoked, this publishable key can no longer create checkout sessions. Any Buy Buttons on your site using this key will stop working. This action cannot be undone.
pk.rowDescription: Change amount and (optionally) currency as needed. This publishable key only accepts requests coming from the domains listed above, and only for amounts ≤ {{max}} {{currency}}.

embedded.title: Embedded Checkout
embedded.description: Accept crypto directly on your site — no redirect. Your server creates a session with your secret key, then the browser mounts the checkout in an iframe. Always confirm payments via webhooks, not the browser event.

elements.errorNoPk: You need at least one active publishable key. Scroll to the Publishable Keys section below and create one — then come back and try the preview.
elements.errorDomainLocked: Preview failed. If your publishable key is domain-locked, add this dashboard's origin to its allowed_domains and retry.
elements.title: Elements — Inline Crypto Widget
elements.description: Render Dynopay’s native crypto payment UI directly in your DOM — no iframe, no redirect. Uses a publishable key (browser-safe) and your customer picks a currency, then pays to the address shown. Always verify fulfillment via webhooks — the browser succeeded event is UX only.
elements.noPkWarning: No publishable key found — the snippet uses a placeholder. Create one in the “Publishable Keys” section below.

webhook.eventOverpaidHint: The customer sent more than requested, above your threshold

webhook.eventSubscriptionsHint: Payment updates (pending, confirmed, underpaid, settled) are always delivered. Tick any extra events you want.

webhook.redirectBody: Your endpoint responds with an HTTP {{status}} redirect. We now follow it automatically so your webhooks are still delivered — but the extra hop adds latency. Update your URL to the final address below to make delivery direct.
